sections.heading: Key Benefits of Health Guard
sections.text: Let’s take a closer look at the standout features that make Health Guard a top-tier option when evaluating different types of insurance policies.

sections.heading: 1. In-Patient Hospitalisation
sections.text: Covers medical expenses when you are hospitalised for a minimum of 24 hours, including room rent, ICU, nursing, surgery, doctor’s fees, and diagnostic charges.

sections.heading: 2. Pre and Post-Hospitalisation
sections.text: You are covered for expenses incurred 60 days before hospitalisation and 90 days after discharge. This includes diagnostic tests, medicines, and consultations.

sections.heading: 4. AYUSH Treatment
sections.text: Treatment expenses for Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy are covered when treatment is taken in a recognised AYUSH hospital.

sections.heading: 6. Preventive Health Check-Up
sections.text: At regular intervals, you get the benefit of a health check-up reimbursement, encouraging proactive healthcare.

sections.heading: 7. Maternity & Newborn Cover
sections.text: Under Gold and Platinum Plans, maternity expenses and coverage for newborn babies (up to 90 days) are included, along with mandatory vaccinations.

sections.heading: 10. Sum Insured Reinstatement
sections.text: If your sum insured is exhausted in a policy year, Health Guard reinstates 100% of your base sum insured — a massive relief during multiple hospitalisations.

sections.heading: Why is Health Insurance Important?
sections.text:
Before diving into the features of the Health Guard plan, let’s understand why having a health insurance policy is crucial:
1. Medical inflation is rising annually, making even minor treatments expensive.
2. Emergencies can strike at any time, without warning.

sections.heading: 3. A single hospitalisation can exhaust years of savings.
sections.text:
4. Health insurance provides financial backing so that quality care is never compromised.
Among the many types of insurance policies available in the market,
health insurance
is one of the most vital, especially in today’s world, where lifestyle-related diseases are becoming more common.
